title: Pedestrian access leg minimum width 1.5 m
text: Where a pedestrian access leg is required to provide access from a dwelling site to a public street, it is to: i. be a minimum width of 1.5m; and The pedestrian access leg may be reduced to 1m where required to retain an existing dwelling.

exceptions.label: reduced to 1 m where required to retain an existing dwelling

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Content twin of Chapter 2 C3.7.8(i), renumbered C3.7.12 in Chapter 3; evaluator, inputs, conditions and exception unchanged. A pedestrian access leg from a dwelling site to a public street. 'Where required to retain' is tested only as the dwelling being retained.
